description: HDSAM models hydrogen-delivery pathways by sizing and linking facilities such as compressors, storage and transport equipment. It combines engineering calculations with discounted cash flow to estimate delivery cost. The provider is Argonne National Laboratory and U.S. DOE. Coverage: Coverage is scenario-defined, from production to dispensing. The DOE page describes gaseous and liquid delivery, including pipelines and trucks; it does not establish a fixed calendar or geography. Access: DOE links the model and user guide through Argonne’s infrastructure-analysis website. No workbook or model was downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The provider describes the analytical method, but model-version details and downstream access terms were not checked. Do not conflate HDSAM with the separately named station models. For simulation it supports comparison of hydrogen-delivery configurations and their cost assumptions. Related resources: No related catalogue record was established as an input, dependency or companion from the provider metadata.
